reason: This is a documented known issue with a clear workaround, not requiring a refund, discretionary exception, or escalation.
reply:
Thanks for flagging this! Yes, this is a known issue (KI-101): CSV export can occasionally omit the "Assignee" column when a task has more than one assignee. Our engineering team is aware and a fix is expected in an upcoming release.

In the meantime, as a workaround, you can export to JSON instead (Settings > Export > choose JSON), which correctly includes all assignees for multi-assignee tasks.

Let us know if you run into anything else!
